task.description:
Update documentation and status for SPT-02/03/04 release:
1. Set SPT-02, SPT-03, SPT-04 status to RELEASED in docs/status/requirement_status.json with released_at, release_run: WF02-spt-02, implemented_in (list of changed files), test_spec, test_run.
2. Add CHANGELOG.md entry under [Unreleased] or new version section for SPT-02/03/04 (Schema-Per-Tenant Migration).
3. git add -A; git commit -m 'docs(WF02-spt-02): update requirement status and changelog for SPT-02/03/04 release'; git push origin feature/WF02-spt-02
4. Create PR: gh pr create --base main --head feature/WF02-spt-02 --title 'feat(SPT): schema-per-tenant migration (SPT-02/03/04)' --body 'Implements schema-per-tenant isolation: drops tenant_id columns, removes bpm.tenant_id session variable, updates test fixtures.

Closes SPT-02, SPT-03, SPT-04'
5. Merge: gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch
6. Switch to main: git checkout main; git pull origin main
acceptance_criteria: SPT-02, SPT-03, SPT-04 status RELEASED in docs/status/requirement_status.json
PR created and merged, branch deleted
